negative_findings.description: English-language searching for Ukrainian payments/banking personnel news surfaced only global trade titles (FinTech Global, FinTech Futures, The Paypers, FF News) and one association/event page; no English-language Ukraine-specific personnel wire was found.

negative_findings.description: Banker.ua, PaySpace Awards content and association newsrooms mix editorial with sponsored/press-release material; several observed items read as promotional.
negative_findings.result_summary: A meaningful share of cell content is PR rather than independent reporting.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Appointment items sourced only from PR need corroboration (NBU register, FinClub, Forbes) before being treated as confirmed leadership moves.

coverage_gaps.description: Even specialist outlets skew to board-level (голова правління, наглядова рада). Genuine second-tier roles — CISO, CTO, head of retail, regional director, head of acquiring — appeared only sporadically (one HRD item on Forbes, NBU department directors on NV/FinClub).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add LinkedIn/company-newsroom and event-speaker-roster collection (EMA and UAFIC conference agendas already identified) as a complementary layer for sub-board roles.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-side personnel coverage is materially thinner than banking-side. PaySpace and EMA are the only strong payments-specific channels found; non-bank PSPs, acquirers, processors and money-transfer operators have no dedicated personnel wire.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Supplement with direct newsroom monitoring of major UA PSPs/processors (e.g. Portmone, LiqPay, iPay.ua, Platon, UAPAY, Fondy, TAS Link) and with NBU's payment-institution register for licensing/structure changes.

coverage_gaps.description: Trade-press appointment reports are announcements, not legal facts; NBU fit-and-proper approval can lag or fail (the Sens Bank board-chair competency procedure is a live example).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair every trade-press appointment record with a check against NBU decisions and the state registry (EDR) to distinguish 'announced' from 'approved/registered'.

coverage_gaps.description: All sources found are Kyiv-centric national outlets; no regional business press covering branch-network restructuring or regional-director moves was identified in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up scout pass on regional Ukrainian business media (Lviv, Dnipro, Kharkiv, Odesa) for branch-network and regional-leadership signals.

coverage_gaps.description: Paywalls (Mind.ua long-form, Forbes.ua features, NV metered) and ad/JS-heavy delivery (psm7, minfin) will limit full-text capture; several small sites (finbalance) have uncertain uptime. No liveness or bot-defence testing was performed in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness/robots pass over all listed URLs; design collectors to store headline+lede+URL when full text is inaccessible, and treat 403/timeout as bot-defended-but-live pending retest.

coverage_gaps.description: Russian-language variants of these outlets (and RU-language Ukrainian financial media) were not searched in this run; some archival personnel records pre-2022 exist mainly in RU.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If historical depth beyond ~2022 is needed, add a ru-language query pass over the same domains (minfin.com.ua/ru, psm7.com/ru, banker.ua/ru).

brief: Ukraine's banking/payments personnel signal lives almost entirely in Ukrainian-language specialist trade press, with FinClub (finclub.net) the single highest-value node — it is the only cell source with an advertised RSS feed and it routinely names individual board chairs, deputies and even NBU department directors. Around it sits a second tier of strong but structurally different sources: Minfin and Mind.ua for volume and entity-keyed streams, Banker.ua and PaySpace Magazine (psm7.com) for banking- and payments-specific beats respectively, Censor.net's 'Наглядова рада' tag and NV Business for state-bank and regulator staffing, and Forbes.ua for the best structured people data (CEO rankings, full bank landscape, functional-role appointments such as HRD/CTO). Industry associations — ЄМА for payments and UAFIC for fintech — are the most promising pointer layer, since their conference speaker rosters expose exactly the sub-board roles the press ignores. The two real weaknesses of this cell are that payments-side personnel coverage is much thinner than banking-side, and that trade-press announcements are not legally confirmed appointments, so every record should be reconciled against NBU decisions before being treated as fact.
